metadata.title: torch.multinomial behaves abnormally with CUDA tensor

bug_description:
## 🐛 Bug



Seems 'torch.multinomial' can not handle high-precisionly drawing from multinomial distribution in CUDA.

trigger_conditions.condition: Using stochastic sampling operators on CUDA with large probability spaces and comparing sampling distribution correctness against CPU or statistical expectations.
trigger_conditions.operation_context: Calling torch.multinomial on a CUDA tensor with a large number of uniform categories (e.g., 1,000,000), replacement=True, and many samples; CPU produces near-uniform counts while CUDA samples only a small biased subset.

failure_behavior.description: Calling torch.multinomial on a CUDA tensor with a large number of uniform categories (e.g., 1,000,000), replacement=True, and many samples; CPU produces near-uniform counts while CUDA samples only a small biased subset.
